name: guardian-ai-vessels

scripts.build:monthly: npm run sync-data-monthly && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.monthly.config.ts && cp dist-monthly/monthly.html dist-monthly/index.html
scripts.build:stacked: npm run sync-data-stacked && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.stacked.config.ts && cp dist-stacked/stacked.html dist-stacked/index.html
scripts.build:fluted: npm run sync-data-fluted && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.fluted.config.ts && cp dist-fluted/fluted.html dist-fluted/index.html
scripts.build:scroll: npm run sync-data-scroll && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.scroll.config.ts && cp dist-scroll/scroll.html dist-scroll/index.html

description: Three-vessel annual preview of Guardian AI tag scores. New copy; does not modify Xiaojun's annual preview.
